title: San Jose | Cupertino Dandiya Nite
description: Experience the Vibrancy of Navratri at San Jose | Cupertino Dandiya Nite
long_description:
Experience the Vibrancy of Navratri at San Jose | Cupertino Dandiya Nite
Mark your calendar for the 17th of October, 2026, as the rhythm of Dandiya beats fill the air in Cupertino. The San Jose | Cupertino Dandiya Nite, brought to you by Net Effect Media, promises an unforgettable evening of Punjabi, Hindi, Telugu, Gujarati and English music, delicious food and drink, and the pulsating energy of Navratri. Whether you're a Bollywood enthusiast or just looking for a great night party, this event brings the vibrant spirit of Navratri to life.
Unveiling the Night with Remarkable Artists
While we're keeping the artists under wraps for now, rest assured that the performers of the night will captivate you with their stellar renditions of various Indian regional music. Their enchanting performances in Punjabi, Hindi, Telugu, and Gujarati will transport you to the heart of India, and their English tunes will have you swaying in rhythm. Stay tuned for more updates!
Cherishing the Night at Marriott Residence Inn
Located at 19429 Stevens Creek Blvd, the Marriott Residence Inn in Cupertino, CA, United States, is a venue that perfectly matches the grandeur of our event. The location is well-regarded for its safety, accessibility, and the variety of attractions nearby. Parking won't be an issue as the venue has ample space for your convenience. What's more, the surrounding area is dotted with Indian restaurants, perfect for those who wish to continue the night with some delicious Indian cuisine.
Securing your Spot at the Dandiya Nite
You wouldn't want to miss this night of fun, dance, and music. Grab your tickets now! Our Early Bird offer gets you a Single Ticket for $24.00, 4 Tickets for $89.00, and 10 Tickets for $199.00. If you missed the Early Bird offer, worry not. Regular tickets are available at $26.00 for a Single Ticket, $96.00 for 4 Tickets, and $220.00 for 10 Tickets. If you decide to join us at the last minute, tickets at the door will be available at $29.00 for a Single Ticket, $108.00 for 4 Tickets, and $249.00 for 10 Tickets. Get ready for a night to remember at the San Jose | Cupertino Dandiya Nite!
